verdict.rationale: Discord's developer platform covers the core of this story. It documents bots and apps that run inside servers (discord-docs-1, discord-docs-41) and authenticate as bot users with a bot token (discord-docs-4, discord-docs-17). Bots receive real-time server events over the Gateway WebSocket (discord-docs-10, discord-docs-20), and users can find and add apps through the App Directory (discord-docs-11). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of mention-triggered replies or message-content events, any first-party AI-agent framing, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent replying when mentioned.
